::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru firm founded 2012 (HPC/AI focus since 2014) designing processors that use the Posit number format instead of floating point. Its TUNGA chip — an 8-core Posit-enabled RISC-V CPU built on C-DAC's VEGA core — taped out and powers the TUNGA accelerator card shown at ISC High Performance 2025.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Posit-arithmetic RISC-V CPUs and accelerator cards for HPC, AI and big-data workloads; the DLI project is an SoC with a POSIT coprocessor.
